scope: Published Life in the UK questions reviewed from production API

summary.reasonForPriority: The content is a citizenship-test subject and every published item needs handbook-level verification before approval.

exactDuplicateReview.topic: The UK Government, the Law and Your Role
exactDuplicateReview.action: Keep one canonical item; replace the other with a distinct, handbook-supported objective.

nearDuplicateReview.pattern: Geographical location or composition of the UK
nearDuplicateReview.action: Retain only distinct learning objectives; verify each answer against the official Guide for New Residents.
Consolidate repeated recall prompts and replace them with applied, source-supported items.
Check whether these test different objectives; otherwise keep one and retire the rest.

nearDuplicateReview.pattern: Political system or structure of the UK
nearDuplicateReview.action: Merge unless the second item tests a clearly different concept.

nearDuplicateReview.pattern: Role of Parliament in making laws
nearDuplicateReview.action: Verify answer choices and retain only distinct objectives.

nearDuplicateReview.pattern: Role of the UK Supreme Court
nearDuplicateReview.action: Merge or rewrite as a different legal-system objective.
Retain one direct definition and make any second item scenario-based if needed.

approvalRule: Use the official GOV.UK Life in the UK test guidance and the current Guide for New Residents as the source of truth. Do not copy or reproduce the official question bank.

authoritativeSources.title: GOV.UK Life in the UK Test
authoritativeSources.note: The official service says the test is based on the official Guide for New Residents and has 24 questions in 45 minutes.
